template:
s1 = winsorize(ts_backfill({special_items_score}, 63), std=4)
s2 = winsorize(ts_backfill({accrued_expenses_score}, 63), std=4)
s3 = winsorize(ts_backfill({revenue_recognition_score}, 63), std=4)
s4 = winsorize(ts_backfill({deferred_rev_score}, 63), std=4)
curr = divide(add(add(add(s1, s2), s3), s4), 4)
hist_mean = ts_mean(curr, 252)
delta = subtract(curr, hist_mean)
delta_z = zscore(delta)
ts_r = ts_rank(curr, 252)
signal = subtract(multiply(0.7, reverse(delta_z)), multiply(0.3, ts_r))
idea: 会计质量恶化动量：检测当前得分相对一年历史均值的偏离（delta），标准化后反转（负向delta代表质量恶化）。同时结合历史分位数（ts_rank），识别当前处于历史极低位置的股票，双重捕捉会计操纵正在恶化的早期信号。
